response.text: INV_NO has the form `V0007-88608-801`, with the invoice ID embedded. I'll compare the middle segment, the supplier's own document number.

arguments.sql: select split_part("INV_NO",'-',2) docno, trim("VEND_CD") v, count(*), array_agg("INV_ID" order by "INV_ID") ids, array_agg("INV_AMT") amts, array_agg("INV_NO") nos, array_agg("INV_DT") dts from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1

select "INV_ID","VEND_CD","INV_NO","INV_DT","INV_AMT","STAT_CD","JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" where "INV_NO" !~ '^V[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$' or split_part("INV_NO",'-',1)<>trim("VEND_CD") or split_part("INV_NO",'-',3)<>"INV_ID"::text limit 30

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", i."INV_DT", i."INV_ID", p."STAT_CD" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" or h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' limit 20
select "JRNL_NO", count(*) from "GLJRNH" group by 1 having count(*)>1
